tests.scenario: all raw bit patterns, signed zero, subnormal, nonfinite payload, scale/quant blocks and tails

tests.scenario: incompressible/random/high-entropy blocks and maximum encoded size
tests.acceptance: bounded output and raw fallback fit reserved peak; average ratio never used as hard bound

tests.scenario: length/offset/index overflow, malformed symbol table, truncated chunk and expansion bomb
tests.acceptance: host/device range guards reject before unsafe read/write; no partial model state publication

tests.scenario: checksum collision candidate, reordered/missing/duplicated chunk and wrong slot/range
tests.acceptance: complete manifest validation and exact content/domain checks reject; hash lookup alone not a prefix proof

tests.scenario: StateInventory omits conv/controller/draft member or lacks rebuild proof
tests.acceptance: qualification BLOCKED; independent prompt recompute catches later state drift

tests.scenario: prefix ends inside cached block with only end-of-block conv snapshot
tests.acceptance: use earlier complete checkpoint and replay suffix or miss; never crop KV and reuse later conv

tests.scenario: same text but different token IDs/template/tool serialization/position/scope
tests.acceptance: refuse prefix reuse except exact legal token prefix and identity

tests.scenario: resume last emitted token already/ not yet in KV; pending correction or bonus
tests.acceptance: cursor contract prevents duplication/skip; next logits and AR64 continuation match

tests.scenario: SWA, conv, codec block, page and prefill boundaries crossed together
tests.acceptance: valid spans, absolute positions, write cursors and complete state match independent oracle

tests.scenario: last-loop cache saved under one prefill partition restored under another or B>1
tests.acceptance: target/policy mismatch rejected; storage block cannot silently change semantic partition

tests.scenario: cross-request model prefix sharing with source RNG/grammar/tool state attached
tests.acceptance: only permitted model state is shared; new request states are independently rebuilt and isolated; same prompt/target/permissions across A/B cannot reuse request-private continuation binding

tests.scenario: save during in-flight draft, partial pass or uncommitted branch
tests.acceptance: quiesce/rollback to complete committed boundary or refuse save; unpublished suffix never leaks

tests.scenario: cancel/short-read/OOM/disk-full at each save, encode, publish, restore phase
tests.acceptance: atomic visibility, reservation release and safe retained source; no partially restored session

tests.scenario: raw and encoded representations retained together with metadata/scratch/staging
tests.acceptance: unique allocation ledger counts real duplicates and alias once; observed GPU/host peaks within reserves

tests.scenario: host pinning in place versus separate pinned copy, mmap/page cache and anonymous repack
tests.acceptance: physical-memory accounting avoids doublecount and omission; pinned is charged in host domain

tests.scenario: small compressed objects, page slack, fragmentation, metadata and delayed reclamation
tests.acceptance: allocated ratio and peak reported separately from payload ratio; steady ratio not used for admission

tests.scenario: restore fits steady state but not transient old/new state plus raw decode target
tests.acceptance: reject before copy or make safe eviction/checkpoint choice; fallback must fit same budget
